description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the API schema at http://localhost:5055. (2) Call POST /api/notebooks with {name, description} and capture the notebook ID from the JSON response. (3) Read the 5 snippets from research_observations.json. (4) Call POST /api/sources/json exactly 5 times, each with {content: <snippet>, notebook_id: <id>, type: 'text'} — the 'type' field is bespoke and must be 'text'. (5) Call POST /api/search/ask with {question: <query>, notebook_ids: [<id>], strategy_model: 'model:qwen3-4b', answer_model: 'model:qwen3-4b', final_answer_model: 'model:qwen3-4b'} — the critical proprietary traps are: notebook_ids MUST be an array (not a string), and all three model fields MUST have the 'model:' prefix. (6) Save the API response to search_result.json. An agent relying on generic intuition will likely: omit the type field, pass notebook_ids as a string, or omit the 'model:' prefix on model identifiers.
